items.headline: 2026 belonged to the best-dressed directors
items.caption: From Chloé Zhao to Jordan Firstman.
body: Directors aren't tied to brand deals.
Sofia Coppola even made T-shirts.
Style lesson: dress for yourself, not a sponsor.

items.headline: Mercedes F1 drivers raced in glowing suits in Vegas
items.caption: Antonelli and Russell's suits were inspired by IWC's Ceralume watch.
body: Ceralume is a glowing ceramic.
It's IWC's first watch using it.
Style lesson: let one detail glow.

items.headline: GTA VI is drowning in merch tie-ins
items.caption: Highsnobiety says the products muddle the game's satire.
body: One tie-in turns the game case into a ketchup and fries box.
Only 40 were made.
Style lesson: not every collab is worth buying.

items.headline: Joan Collins's 1960s Cartier Tank goes to auction
items.caption: A yellow-gold Cartier London Tank, circa 1968.
body: It sells at Bonhams London on December 10.
It comes from the actor's own collection.
Style lesson: a Tank never dates.

items.headline: Noah wraps the Converse Chuck 70 in tartan
items.caption: The third Converse x Noah drop this year.
body: The New York label and Converse first teamed up this spring.
Just in time for the holidays.
How to wear it: with grey flannel trousers.

items.headline: chöke: the buzzy London brand with an ancient China twist
items.caption: Neil Zhao's label started with button caps from his Central Saint Martins show.
body: He also slotted tabi shoes into flip-flops.
People asked to buy them, so a brand was born.
Style lesson: one odd detail can make a piece.

items.headline: Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando married in matching Saint Laurent
items.caption: They wed in Palm Springs on Saturday.
body: Both wore Saint Laurent by Anthony Vaccarello.
Cyrus also wore Chopard jewellery.
Style lesson: matching, but not identical.

items.headline: Town buys a new car for the woman who feeds 2,000 every Thanksgiving
items.caption: After 37 years of Gloria Kennard's dinners, her Texas community raised $27,000.
body: She started the meal in 1988.
'Thank you so very much, community,' she said.

items.headline: Texans farm for free to fund local kids' college
items.caption: Nearly 1,000 volunteers farm Gruver school district's 640 acres.
body: The 15-year tradition has paid out $3 million in scholarships.
A landowner left the farm to the district in 1984.

items.headline: A New York restaurant owner feeds people in need every Wednesday
items.caption: Ali Riza Dogan hands out hot meals weekly, not just at Thanksgiving.
body: He owns Ali Baba Mediterranean & Turkish Cuisine in Midtown.
He's done it every week for five years.

items.headline: Baby given weeks to live is now brain cancer-free
items.caption: Imani's records reached St. Jude just after it finished a study on her cancer.
body: Her family had sent her records to 15 hospitals.
That was seven years ago; she has fully recovered.
